nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the privileged owner of the contract.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
External function guarded by an owner check that forwards a transferFrom call on a supplied token.
Caller-supplied address used for the constructor owner assignment and for the access control require.
External call _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,_amount) made to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address, enabling untrusted code execution.
Parameter _token: caller-supplied IERC20Token interface used as the external call target.
Parameter _sender: caller-supplied source address passed to transferFrom.
Parameter _receiver: caller-supplied destination address passed to transferFrom.
Parameter _amount: caller-supplied value passed to transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender value into the owner state variable.
The require(msg.sender == owner) check gates execution of transferUniswapV3LessGas based on the untrusted caller identity.
The function body executes the external token transferFrom call after the owner check passes.
The _token parameter flows directly into the external call target of transferFrom.
The _sender parameter flows directly into the from address argument of transferFrom.
The _receiver parameter flows directly into the to address argument of transferFrom.
The _amount parameter flows directly into the value argument of transferFrom.
The external transferFrom call hands control to an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract, which can re-enter transferUniswapV3LessGas before the original call returns.

normalization_plan.reason: The _token parameter is only used as the target of the external transferFrom call, so it can be folded into that unsafe operation node.
The _sender parameter is only consumed as the from argument of the external transferFrom call, so it merges into that unsafe operation node.
The _receiver parameter is only consumed as the to argument of the external transferFrom call, so it merges into that unsafe operation node.
The _amount parameter is only consumed as the value argument of the external transferFrom call, so it merges into that unsafe operation node.
